title: Bat holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Balloon string -->
  <path d='M65 40 Q62 55 58 65' stroke='#BBBBBB' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  <!-- Balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='67' cy='28' rx='12' ry='14' fill='#FF5577'/>
  <ellipse cx='67' cy='28' rx='9' ry='11' fill='#FF7788' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- Balloon knot -->
  <polygon points='65,42 69,42 67,45' fill='#DD4466'/>
  <!-- Balloon highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='23' rx='3' ry='4' fill='#FFAABB' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- Bat body -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='65' rx='14' ry='16' fill='#5B4A8A'/>
  <!-- Bat belly -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='68' rx='9' ry='11' fill='#7B6AAA'/>
  <!-- Left wing -->
  <path d='M24 58 Q10 45 8 60 Q6 72 14 74 Q20 72 24 66 Z' fill='#4A3A7A'/>
  <path d='M20 60 Q12 50 11 60 Q10 68 15 69' fill='#6A5A9A' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- Right wing -->
  <path d='M52 58 Q66 45 70 58 Q72 70 62 74 Q54 72 52 66 Z' fill='#4A3A7A'/>
  <path d='M56 60 Q64 50 65 60 Q66 68 60 69' fill='#6A5A9A' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- Bat head -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='48' rx='13' ry='11' fill='#5B4A8A'/>
  <!-- Left ear -->
  <polygon points='28,42 24,30 34,38' fill='#5B4A8A'/>
  <polygon points='28,41 26,33 32,38' fill='#8B7AAA'/>
  <!-- Right ear -->
  <polygon points='48,42 52,30 42,38' fill='#5B4A8A'/>
  <polygon points='48,41 50,33 44,38' fill='#8B7AAA'/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='33' cy='47' r='3' fill='#FFDD44'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='47' r='3' fill='#FFDD44'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='47' r='1.5' fill='#332244'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='47' r='1.5' fill='#332244'/>
  <!-- Fangs -->
  <polygon points='35,54 36.5,54 35.75,57' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <polygon points='40,54 41.5,54 40.75,57' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M35 54 Q38 56 41 54' stroke='#3A2A6A' stroke-width='0.8' fill='none'/>
  <!-- Left arm holding string -->
  <path d='M50 62 Q58 65 62 63' stroke='#5B4A8A' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Right arm -->
  <path d='M26 62 Q20 66 18 70' stroke='#5B4A8A' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Feet -->
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='81' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#4A3A7A'/>
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='81' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#4A3A7A'/>
  <!-- Small stars sparkle -->
  <circle cx='18' cy='24' r='1.2' fill='#FFDD66'/>
  <circle cx='82' cy='48' r='1.2' fill='#FFDD66'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='20' r='1' fill='#FFDD66'/>
</svg>
